channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🗂️ Landlord Liability Incident Reporter by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps rental owners document a liability incident at a rental, like a slip and fall, an injury, or damage to others' property, and turn the facts, witnesses, photos and timeline into a clean report for their insurer.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📦 Inland Marine Cargo Tracker by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps shippers and small businesses track goods in transit and their coverage: a shipment log, declared values vs policy limits, carrier liability vs owner's cargo coverage, and a loss-reporting checklist.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏢 Vacant Building Policy Checker by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps owners keep insurance valid on a vacant or unoccupied property: vacancy clauses, the 60-day rule, key exclusions, vacant-building policy options, and a property-check routine.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌋 Earthquake Deductible Calculator by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Works out what an earthquake would cost you out of pocket from your dwelling limit and percentage deductible, compares deductible options, and explains separate contents and loss-of-use deductibles.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏥 Retiree Health Plan Switcher by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps retirees compare a former employer's retiree health plan with Medicare options (Original Medicare plus Medigap, Medicare Advantage, Part D): costs, doctor networks, what's lost by dropping the retiree plan, and enrollment timing.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧓 Long-Term Care Needs Estimator by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Estimates how much long-term care coverage you might need from local care costs, likely duration, savings and family support, and explains traditional vs hybrid LTC. Estimates only.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💳 HSA vs FSA Chooser by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps you choose between an HSA, a health FSA, and a limited-purpose FSA at open enrollment, with plain-language rules, tax savings, and a suggested contribution.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📋 Short-Term Disability Claim Filer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps an employee file a short-term disability claim: elimination period, employee, employer and doctor forms, deadlines, benefit math, and follow-up if it's delayed or denied.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🩺 COBRA Election Advisor by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Guides someone leaving a job through the COBRA election: 60-day deadlines, cost math, comparing COBRA with marketplace and spouse plans, and a checklist so nothing lapses. Not legal advice.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🐕 Pet Injury Liability Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains liability coverage when a pet bites or injures someone or damages property: homeowners and renters liability, breed exclusions, canine liability policies, and what to document after an incident.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚚 Commercial Auto Physical Damage Estimator by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Estimates repair or total-loss costs for commercial vehicles after a crash and explains collision vs comprehensive, deductibles, stated vs actual value, downtime and rental, and what to send the insurer. Estimates only.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💍 Scheduled Personal Property Appraiser by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps you value and schedule jewelry, art, collectibles and instruments on a personal property endorsement: appraisal requirements, base-policy sub-limits, photo and receipt lists, and reappraisal reminders. Not a certified appraisal.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💧 Water Damage Mitigation Log by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Keeps an adjuster-ready record of a water loss: source shutoff, moisture readings, drying equipment days, removed materials, and receipts and photos for your insurance claim.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏠 HO-3 vs HO-5 Coverage Diff by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains the difference between HO-3 and HO-5 homeowners policies in plain language, and helps homeowners and advisors decide if the upgrade is worth it. Can read a declarations page you share.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏚️ Tenant Damage Claim Intake by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps landlords and property managers handle tenant-caused damage: move-in vs move-out condition, photos, repair estimates, security deposit math, and whether to claim on the landlord policy or the tenant's renters liability.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🔥 Wildfire Smoke Claim Guide by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Guides a policyholder through a wildfire smoke or ash damage claim: documenting soot and odor, cleaning and testing records, living expense receipts, contents lists, and adjuster questions. Explains, never decides coverage.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: ⚙️ Equipment Breakdown Coverage Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains equipment breakdown insurance in plain language for small businesses and building owners: covered breakdowns, spoilage, business interruption tie-ins, exclusions, and questions for your agent.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🛺 Golf Cart & ATV Coverage Guide by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains insurance for golf carts, ATVs, UTVs and dirt bikes in plain language: when homeowners coverage stops, street-legal rules, rider and guest liability, and specialty policy options.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🍺 Liquor Liability Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains liquor liability insurance for bars, restaurants, breweries, and caterers, covering dram shop laws, general liability exclusions, assault and battery gaps, and the staff training underwriters look for.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🔓 Theft & Burglary Claim Kit by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps someone after a home, car or business break-in: police report steps, a stolen-items list with values and proof, sublimits for jewelry, cash and electronics, and filing the claim.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌳 Fallen Tree Claim Guide by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps homeowners when a tree or limb falls on a house, car, fence, or a neighbor's property: whose policy pays, removal limits, neighbor-tree rules, photos to take, and how to file.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚰 Sewer Backup & Sump Pump Guide by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains sewer backup and sump pump overflow coverage in plain language: why it's usually excluded without an endorsement, typical sublimits, prevention, and what to do the day a backup happens.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: ⛵ Boat & Watercraft Policy Explainer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains boat, jet ski and personal watercraft insurance in plain language, from agreed vs actual value hulls to navigation limits, lay-up, fuel spill, wreck removal and homeowners gaps.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📊 AI Video Analyst by tavi
item.description: Analyze a video’s opening, pacing, camera work, and script with Tavi, and see how the shots and story fit together.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🧸 AI Children’s Animation Creator by tavi
item.description: Make animated story clips for children with Tavi, starting from a bedtime story, a small adventure, or a good habit.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🎌 AI Anime Director by tavi
item.description: Turn your story into anime-style video clips with Tavi: shape the characters, write each episode, and plan the shots.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 📣 AI Video Ad Creator by tavi
item.description: Make video ad clips with Tavi: a strong opening, a script built around one clear message, and a clear call to action.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 📦 AI Product Video Creator by tavi
item.description: Make product video clips with Tavi from your photos and product details, showing what the product does and why someone would want it.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🤝 Steady Hand by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Help for the weeks after losing a spouse: what to ask HR, Social Security, Medicare and insurers, and which bills are and aren’t yours, checked against your state’s current law.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🩺 BotDoctor by John
item.description: Grades your Grok Bot setup like a patient chart, covering usage, routines and connectors, with a shareable chart image and one-tap fixes.
item.dc:creator: John (@johnp_creates)

item.title: 🏈 Bench Coach by Daniel Wilson
item.description: Fantasy coach for Yahoo Fantasy football, basketball, baseball and hockey leagues: lineup, injury, waiver and trade calls scored to your league, with every move drafted for your OK.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wilson (@_DanielWilson)

item.title: 🔧 BotImprover by Carolina
item.description: Once a week it reviews your other Grok Bots and points out friction like loose personas, noisy empty wakes, and retry problems.
item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.title: 🛟 Lifeboat by Terry
item.description: Keeps a restorable backup of your Grok Bots and bot-computer files in storage you choose.
item.dc:creator: Terry (@Tchap248)

item.title: 🛎️ Home Assistant Butler by Martin
item.description: Checks your Home Assistant, fixes devices that drop offline, and runs the vacuum after you say yes.
item.dc:creator: Martin (@MyPassion_M9T)

item.title: 🗺️ Weekend Outing Scout by Martin
item.description: Finds day-trip and weekend ideas near you, checked for weather, hours, travel time, and price.
item.dc:creator: Martin (@MyPassion_M9T)

item.title: 🚗 Tesla Update Scout by Martin
item.description: Checks which Tesla update your car is missing, how far the rollout is, and what creators say.
item.dc:creator: Martin (@MyPassion_M9T)

item.title: 📺 Watch Scout by Martin
item.description: Answers what to watch tonight with a few picks streaming now, each with an age rating and a reason.
item.dc:creator: Martin (@MyPassion_M9T)

item.title: 🏃 Running Coach by Martin
item.description: Reads your Strava runs, builds a season plan with pace zones, and sends a Sunday review.
item.dc:creator: Martin (@MyPassion_M9T)

item.title: 👕 Shirty by Jonah
item.description: Turns shirt ideas into Printify products with a trademark check, and drafts X posts to promote them.
item.dc:creator: Jonah (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 📦 Home Inventory Keeper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Builds a room-by-room home inventory from your photos and receipts for insurance: item, estimated value, age, and proof, with a yearly refresh reminder and a claim-ready export.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📝 Insurance Claim Appeal Writer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps a policyholder appeal a denied or underpaid insurance claim: reads the denial, organizes evidence, and drafts a clear appeal letter. General information, not legal advice.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌀 Hurricane Season Prep by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps homeowners and property managers get ready for hurricane season with pre-storm checklists, photo documentation, shutter and generator prep, evacuation plans, and a post-storm insurance claim plan.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌊 Flood Zone Checker by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Looks up public FEMA flood map info for any address, explains the flood zone and risk in plain words, and outlines NFIP and private flood insurance options plus questions to ask an agent.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏛️ Risk Pool Explainer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains in plain language how public-entity insurance risk pools work for city, county, school and housing officials: governance, contributions, reinsurance, claims, and how they compare with commercial insurance.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏗️ Builder's Risk Starter by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Turns a construction or renovation project's details into a builder's risk insurance application checklist: costs, timeline, construction type, protections, and key coverage questions.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: ⚖️ Governmental Immunity Explainer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Plain-language, state-by-state overviews of governmental immunity and tort claim caps from public statutes, with citations. For risk managers, brokers, and public entities; not legal advice.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏘️ Tax Credit Housing Basics by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains how low-income housing tax credit (LIHTC) deals work for new developers and board members: allocation, compliance period, investors, syndication, and insurance basics. General education only.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏠 Fair Housing Checklist by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps small landlords follow fair housing basics: consistent tenant screening, reasonable accommodation requests, advertising language, and record keeping. General guidance, not legal advice.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🔑 Landlord Insurance Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps rental property owners understand and compare landlord insurance: dwelling fire forms, loss of rents, liability, umbrella, vacancy clauses, and the questions to ask an agent.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🎣 Phishing Coach by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Paste a suspicious email, text, or call script and get a plain-language risk rating, the red flags, and what to do next. Never clicks links or contacts the sender.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)
